reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Sleep is where most of your recovery happens, so it's a fair thing to be thinking about. I can't tell you whether melatonin is right for you or what dose to take. That's a question for your doctor or a pharmacist, especially if you're on any other medication. In the meantime, the training side helps most: keep bedtime and wake time roughly consistent, and try to get your hard sessions done at least a few hours before bed. When you're ready to build the program, tell me your goal and how many days a week you can train."}
